blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Pampanga Rep. Aurelio “Dong” Gonzales on Tuesday said he would prove his innocence before the Sandiganbayan, where three counts of graft had been filed against him. Gonzales made the remark after posting P90,000 bail before the anti-graft court’s Third Division, which is handling his case. “I will prove myself innocent,” Gonzales said in an ambush interview. Gonzales posted P270,000 bail for the three graft cases. Last week, he posted P90,000 bail each before the Second and Seventh divisions, which are handling one count each. READ: Ex-Pampanga Rep.
